name: Pitwall
description: A live pit wall for your coding agents: context, cost, subagents and every tool call, in Orca's right sidebar. Read-only and local; the optional Crew section reads an Agni crew over your own SSH.

cover.alt: Pitwall: watch every coding agent from Orca's sidebar, with who is waiting on you, context and cost

screenshots.alt: Pitwall in dark and light: an agent asking for permission, a working agent with subagents, context and tool calls

commands.title: Pitwall: Switch between focused workspace and all workspaces
Pitwall: Show or hide the Agni crew section
Pitwall: Clear tool calls and log

settings.title: Show estimated cost
settings.description: API list price of the tokens in the transcript. On a Claude subscription this is what the same work would cost on the API, not what you pay.

settings.title: Context gauge measures against
settings.description: auto: Claude Code's auto-compact window when you set one (modelSettings.<model>.autoCompactWindow), else the model's window.

settings.title: Claude Code config folder
settings.description: Where Claude Code keeps projects/ and settings.json. Empty: $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, else ~/.claude.

settings.title: Show the Agni crew section
settings.description: Off by default. Reads the crew's tasks and seats from the crew host, and the crew keys' spend from the gateway host, over your own SSH (BatchMode, no new ports). Read-only.

settings.title: Crew host (SSH alias)
settings.description: Where `crew` runs. Pitwall runs `ssh <alias> python3 -` with a read-only script.

settings.title: Gateway host (SSH alias)
settings.description: Where the LiteLLM gateway runs. Its master key is read there and never leaves that host.
